blocks.text: Sahara dene wale (supporting) tissues podon ki banawati salamti, sahara aur lachak qaim rakhte hain. Yeh parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma, xylem aur phloem hain.

Parenchyma narm-tana (herbaceous) podon aur bare podon ke hisson ko sahara deta hai. Epidermis, cortex aur pith ke parenchyma cells pani jazb karte hain, jo andar ek hydrostatic dabao, turgor pressure, paida karta hai jo cells ki sakhti qaim rakhta hai. Turgor pressure cell ke vacuole mein barhe hue osmotic pressure se paida hota hai. Vacuole ke gird ki jhilli, tonoplast, mein bohat se active transport ke nizam hain jo ions ko vacuole mein le jate hain, chahe andar concentration pehle hi gird ke mahlool se zyada ho. Barhi hui ionic concentration ki wajah se pani vacuole mein khincha chala aata hai, jo pode ke narm tissues ko turgidity aur mechanical sahara deta hai.

Collenchyma cells khaas cells hain jo naujawan tanon aur patton ke danthal (leaf stalks) ki epidermis ke neeche aur patton ki ragon ke saath dhaagon ya cylinders mein jure hote hain. In mein sanvi (secondary) deewarein nahin hotin; in ki ibtidai (primary) deewarein konon par cellulose ki izafi tahon se moti hoti hain. Jab tana ya patta lambai mein barhta hai to yeh lambe hote hain, aur pode ke un naujawan hisson ko sahara dete hain jin mein secondary growth nahin hui.

Sclerenchyma bhi banawati sahara deta hai. Is ke cells ki aam taur par moti secondary deewarein hoti hain jo lignin se bhari hoti hain, ek organic compound jo mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai, aur zyada tar sclerenchyma cells ghair-zinda (non-living) hain. Is tissue ka asal kaam sahara hai. Sclerenchyma cell ki teen qismein hain: fibres, sclereids aur vessels. Fibres (tracheids) lambe aur belan-numa (cylindrical) hain, xylem ke andar ghane guchhon ya bundle caps ke taur par milte hain. Sclereids fibres se chhote hain aur beej ke chhilkon (seed coats) aur giri (nuts) ke khol mein hote hain, jahan yeh hifazat dete hain. Vessels (tracheae) lambi nali-numa banawatein hain jo sira-ba-sira jur kar xylem ki pani le jane wali lambi nalian banati hain.

blocks.alt: Teen qism ke cells. Parenchyma: gol patli-deewar wale cells har ek mein bara neela vacuole. Collenchyma: konedar cells jin ke sabz mote kone. Sclerenchyma: tang lumen wale do lambe bhoore fibres aur nanhe lumen wale do gol bhoore sclereids.
blocks.caption: Parenchyma, collenchyma aur sclerenchyma (Figure 8.6 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Parenchyma cells ki patli deewarein aur bare vacuoles hain; vacuole mein pump kiye gaye ions pani kheenchte hain, aur turgor pressure narm herbaceous tissue ko sakht rakhta hai. Collenchyma cells zinda hain, un ki primary deewarein konon par izafi cellulose se moti hain, aur yeh naujawan barhte hisson ko sahara dete hain. Sclerenchyma cells ki moti lignin wali secondary deewarein hain aur yeh zyada tar murda hain; fibres, beej ke chhilkon aur giri ke khol ke sclereids, aur xylem ke vessels is mein aate hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek paneeri (seedling) achhi tarah seenchne par seedhi rehti hai magar sookhne par jhuk jati hai, jab ke darakht ka tana kabhi nahin jhukta. Har soorat mein sahara dene wala tissue batayein aur farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Paneeri ko parenchyma ka turgor seedha rakhta hai: vacuoles mein pump kiye gaye ions pani kheenchte hain, aur dabao cells ko sakht rakhta hai, is liye pani kam ho to cells flaccid ho jate hain aur poda murjha jata hai. Tane ko sclerenchyma aur xylem sahara dete hain jin ki moti lignin wali deewarein cells mein pani ho ya na ho sakht rehti hain, is liye woh nahin jhukta.

items: Sahara dene wale tissues: parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma, xylem aur phloem.
Parenchyma turgor pressure se sahara deta hai: tonoplast ions vacuole mein pump karta hai, pani peeche aata hai, cell apni deewar ke khilaf phoolta hai.

Collenchyma (zinda, kone cellulose se mote) naujawan tanon, patton ke danthal aur ragon ko sahara deta hai. Sclerenchyma (lignin wali secondary deewarein, zyada tar murda) sakht sahara deta hai: fibres, sclereids aur vessels.
